_comment: Corrections to STAGE (not deploy) on the existing staged-create service sourcing-staging, environment staging of project app.nordla.app. Non-secret values only. Applied by the Railway session after the owner's go; then the whole lot is re-audited (docs/infrastructure/railway-changeset-audit.md section 5). UPDATED 2026-10-17 for the merged candidate: pinned commit is the core-p0 merge commit; 'settings_to_verify_or_add' lists two Railway settings that were missing from the first list. Still NOT applied.

settings_to_verify_or_add.config_as_code_path: /deploy/sourcing/railway.json  (without it the repository-root railway.json wins: start command without the Docker entrypoint, no Dockerfile builder = root user, no prepared volume)
settings_to_verify_or_add.auto_deploy_on_push: OFF or pinned to the commit above (the source branch claude/nordla-core-p0 receives pushes from several chantiers: each push would redeploy staging uncontrolled)
